intro.text: An honorspren, first mate of the ship Honor's Path.

items.text: When the Honor's Path took Syl and her companions aboard, Azure told Borea that her Blade was a Shardblade made without a spren, and offered to explain how it was made in return for the weapon, news of Nightblood and passage onward. Borea drew the Blade herself, was shocked that it needed no enslaved spren, and agreed.

appearance.text: Like Notum, Borea wears a stiff, no-nonsense uniform.
